panel.title: Quotes
panel.emptyBody: Build a quotation with sales tax and send it as a PDF on WhatsApp or by email.

document.title: Quotation
document.subject: Subject
document.noItems: Add items to see them on the quotation.
document.footer: Prices are in Pakistani rupees (PKR). Sales tax is charged at {{rate}}% under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. This quotation is not a sales tax invoice.
document.label: Quotation {{number}}

builder.itemsHint: Service fees exclude sales tax. {{rate}}% sales tax is added to the total.
builder.priceListEmpty: Nothing on the price list matches.
builder.suggestion: This deal looks like {{name}}. Start from its service package?
builder.validityHintToday: Valid until the end of today
builder.notesHint: Printed at the bottom of the quotation, e.g. fees the student pays directly or payment terms.
builder.defaultNotes: Embassy visa fees, university application fees, IHS and tuition deposits are paid by the student directly and are not included in this quotation.
builder.noTrnWarning: Your workspace has no NTN yet, so it won't print on this quote. The owner can add it in Settings.
builder.noDealBody: Quotes belong to a deal. Open a deal and choose New quote.

send.title: Send to {{name}}
send.windowClosed: Ask {{name}} to reply on WhatsApp first; quotes can only be sent inside the 24-hour window. The window closed {{ago}}.
send.windowNever: {{name}} hasn't messaged you on WhatsApp yet. Quotes can only be sent inside the 24-hour window after they write to you.
send.windowShort: Ask {{name}} to reply on WhatsApp first
send.emailMissing: Add an email address for {{name}} to send by email.
send.emailNoConnection: Connect a Gmail mailbox in Settings to send by email.

outcome.title: Did {{name}} decide?
outcome.body: Record the answer so the team knows where this deal stands.
outcome.acceptedNote: {{name}} accepted this quote. Move the deal forward once the first instalment is paid and documents are in.
outcome.rejectedNote: {{name}} turned this quote down. You can build a new quote on the deal.
outcome.rejectBody: The quote stays on the deal as rejected and can't be sent for a decision again. Build a new quote if the price or items change.

pdf.failed: The PDF couldn't be created. Try again.
